AspendoraSiteAudit.AllIssues: Site Audit: all issues by URL
AspendoraSiteAudit.IssueSummaryDocumentation: Our weekly crawl of the site (self-hosted replacement for Ahrefs Site Audit). The crawler starts at the configured start URL plus every URL in the sitemaps, follows internal links, and checks status codes, redirects, titles, meta descriptions, canonicals, noindex, H1s, sitemap coverage, orphan pages, response time and Open Graph tags. Thresholds match the website's pre-deploy check (check:seo): title at most 60 characters, description 110–160. This report shows the latest successful crawl that finished on or before the end of the selected date range (pick a date to see an older crawl). URLs = distinct URLs with the issue. New = URLs with the issue now that did not have it in the previous crawl; Fixed = URLs that had it in the previous crawl and no longer do (both 0 after the first crawl). Errors are listed first, then warnings, then notices.
AspendoraSiteAudit.IssuesDocumentation: Every issue found by the latest successful weekly crawl up to the selected date, one row per URL and issue, with the detail (e.g. the broken link target, the redirect chain, the title length). New = 1 when the URL did not have this issue in the previous crawl. Use the search box to filter by URL or issue name.
AspendoraSiteAudit.PagesDocumentation: Every URL fetched by the latest successful weekly crawl up to the selected date: HTTP status, response time, click depth from the start URL (empty = only reachable via the sitemap), whether it is in the sitemap and indexable (200 HTML, no noindex, canonical self or absent), title and description length, H1 count, word count and number of internal links.
AspendoraSiteAudit.RunsDocumentation: History of weekly site audit crawls (the last 26 are kept). Counts are issue rows by severity. A failed run keeps its error in Note; a run still marked running after 2 hours is marked failed.
AspendoraSiteAudit.NoRunYet: No completed site audit crawl yet on or before this date. It runs weekly; to run it now: ./console aspendora-audit:run
AspendoraSiteAudit.Issue_indexable_not_in_sitemap: Indexable page missing from the sitemap
AspendoraSiteAudit.Issue_sitemap_url_not_200: Sitemap URL is not 200 (redirect or error)
AspendoraSiteAudit.Issue_orphan: Orphan page (no internal links point here)
